_comment: LEGACY TEMPLATE (kept for reference): this was the original OpenLane 2 config. The committed physical-implementation results were produced with LibreLane 3.x from synth/ol_<design>.yaml instead -- use those. If you do run this file, CLOCK_PERIOD (14.6 ns, 68.5 MHz) matches the shared constraint in synth/constraints.sdc and must stay identical across all three headline runs. Licensed Apache-2.0, see repo LICENSE.

configs_why.SYNTH_STRATEGY: AREA 0 makes Yosys/ABC optimize for area over speed, which is the metric being compared
configs_why.DIE_AREA: generous on purpose so placement congestion is not a confounder
configs_why.CLOCK_PERIOD: ONE shared period for all three, derived from the widest config (see synth/constraints.sdc)
